subject: Year-end stewardship & change-control playbook
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Year-end stewardship & change-control playbook

Team —

As we start scoping the annual performance window, I put together an operational playbook focusing on two things we flagged last year: tight change-control for sensitive role adjustments and an explicit stewardship path for manager handoffs (so talent moves do not accidentally leak). Attached is a first draft (yearend_playbook_draft_v1.docx) and a one-sheet control matrix (succession_control_matrix.xlsx).

High-level asks:
- Read the playbook and call out any legal, compensation, or privacy blockers by EOD Friday (14 May).
- Confirm who will be the primary steward for off-cycle promotions and which backup team owns approvals.
- Agree on a short manager consent flow so we can distribute the forms to people managers the week before calibration.

I propose a small leadership sync Tuesday 18 May, 10–10:30 PT, to lock the timeline and signoffs. If we have outstanding legal items we can push timelines, but I want alignment on owner responsibilities before comms go out.

Attachments: yearend_playbook_draft_v1.docx (draft), succession_control_matrix.xlsx (matrix)

Thanks —
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of People Ops (Comp & Org)
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Year-end stewardship & change-control playbook

Tessa —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a skim:
- We need the manager consent flow to include a place for GC review on any off-cycle compensation > $50k run-rate. Can you add that threshold?
- For steward backups: I recommend Marissa be primary for engineering/org moves and Laura be backup. Marissa, can you accept?
- Please loop Legal and Mercer for privacy/notice language; if Mercer has a standard consent template that reduces lift, that'd be ideal.

I can make the Tuesday 18 May slot. If legal needs more time we should still agree on the rest of the timeline so teams know when to expect comms.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
COO

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Year-end stewardship & change-control playbook — consent language and template

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for sharing the draft. Attached is a manager consent template we typically use for talent moves that touch payroll or PII (manager_consent_form.pdf). Two quick items:
1) Privacy notice: include a line that we will retain the consent record for 3 years; this aligns with common audits.
2) Legal escalation: if a move is contested (employee appeals), add a pause gate and a holder for Legal review — Mercer can populate suggested language.

We can also run a short training for people managers on the consent flow if you want us to slot a 45-minute session during the rollout.

Attachment: manager_consent_form.pdf

Best,
Sofia R. (on behalf of Mercer Consulting)
People Ops Delivery Lead
ops@mercerhr.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Year-end stewardship & change-control playbook

Team —

Thanks, all. A couple of additions from my side after reviewing the matrix and promise of the consent template:

- Manager peer-review: I support a lightweight peer sign-off for promotions (single checkbox + short rationale). That will reduce churn during steward review.
- Communication cadence: Proposed timeline: manager training 23–24 May; manager consent collection open 27 May–3 June; manager to submit final calibration packets 7 June; leadership calibration 14 June. If legal needs extra time, we can put a small buffer week between manager consent close and packet submission.
- Sensitive lane: For sensitive roles (security, infra), add an additional whisper-only notification to security leadership so they can flag operational risks. I'll draft exact wording; want Marissa to confirm process.

Can everyone commit to the 23–24 May training window so we can hit the June cadence? If not, call it out here and we will adjust.

Karthik
SVP, People Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Mercer Consulting <ops@mercerhr.com>, Outsourced Legal <acme-legal@outsourced-legal.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Year-end stewardship & change-control playbook — final sync and owners

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary of decisions from our sync: 
- Owners: Marissa (primary steward for engineering/org moves), Laura (backup).
- Threshold: GC review for any off-cycle comp > $50k run-rate (Vivek to confirm exact approval routing with Legal).
- Timeline locked: manager training 23–24 May; consent collection 27 May–3 June; final packets 7 June; leadership calibration 14 June.
- Sensitive lane: security leadership will be blind-cc'd on the steward queue for flagged roles. Karthik will draft the notification language by 20 May.
- Legal/Privacy: Mercer will provide consent template and suggested retention language. Legal to confirm appeal/pause gate wording by EOD Monday (24 May).

Next steps (action owners):
- Marissa: publish manager checklist + handoff template (due Mon 16 May — in progress).
- Tessa: update playbook with consent threshold and upload v2 to the Drive (will attach yearend_playbook_draft_v2.docx).
- Karthik: draft sensitive-lane notification wording (due 20 May).
- Legal (cc'd): confirm pause-gate language (due 24 May).

I'll circulate a one-paragraph comms note to ELT once Legal confirms the pause-gate. Thanks everyone — feeling good about this operational surface.

Tessa
Head of People Ops (Comp & Org)
Redwood Inference
